title: Tuberculosis Laboratory
content: Tuberculosis Laboratory notebook template with workflow pages for sample accession, quality check, initial processing, incubation, test execution, isolate storage, disposal/archiving, and reporting.

pages.title: Sample Accession & Registration
pages.instructions: Import TB samples from delivery manifest with complete metadata. Verify sample information and mark as verified to proceed.
pages.content: Sample Accession & Registration - Complete metadata entry and verification for TB samples

manifestColumns.label: Sample ID
manifestColumns.description: Unique identifier assigned to the TB specimen at collection or referral.

manifestColumns.label: Specimen Type
manifestColumns.description: Type of clinical specimen submitted for TB testing (e.g., sputum, BAL, pleural fluid, urine).

manifestColumns.label: Number of Samples
manifestColumns.description: Total number of specimen containers included in this submission.

manifestColumns.label: Specimen Quality
manifestColumns.description: Visual quality assessment of the specimen (e.g., mucopurulent, saliva, blood-stained).

manifestColumns.label: Document Number
manifestColumns.description: Reference number of the request form or referral document accompanying the specimen.

manifestColumns.label: Referring Facility
manifestColumns.description: Name of the health facility that referred the patient and sent the specimen.

manifestColumns.label: Patient Name
manifestColumns.description: Full name of the patient from whom the specimen was collected.

manifestColumns.label: Patient Age
manifestColumns.description: Age of the patient at the time of specimen collection.

manifestColumns.label: Patient Sex
manifestColumns.description: Biological sex of the patient (Male, Female, Unknown).

manifestColumns.label: Patient ID
manifestColumns.description: National or facility-assigned patient identifier.

manifestColumns.label: Study ID
manifestColumns.description: Identifier of the research study or surveillance programme this specimen is enrolled in.

manifestColumns.label: Treatment History
manifestColumns.description: Patient's prior TB treatment history (e.g., New, Previously Treated, Treatment After Failure).

manifestColumns.label: Culture Result
manifestColumns.description: Result of mycobacterial culture test (e.g., Positive, Negative, Contaminated).

manifestColumns.label: Smear Microscopy
manifestColumns.description: Result of Ziehl-Neelsen or fluorescence smear microscopy (e.g., 1+, 2+, 3+, Negative, Scanty).

manifestColumns.label: GeneXpert Result
manifestColumns.description: Result of GeneXpert MTB/RIF assay (e.g., MTB Detected/RIF Resistance Detected, Not Detected).
manifestColumns.example: MTB Detected; RIF Resistance Not Detected

manifestColumns.label: Identification Result
manifestColumns.description: Species identification result for the mycobacterial isolate (e.g., M. tuberculosis, M. bovis).

manifestColumns.label: DST First Line
manifestColumns.description: Drug susceptibility testing result for first-line anti-TB drugs (e.g., H-R-Z-E: S/R/S/S).

manifestColumns.label: DST Second Line
manifestColumns.description: Drug susceptibility testing result for second-line anti-TB drugs (e.g., Km, Am, Lfx, Mfx).

manifestColumns.label: Received Site
manifestColumns.description: Name of the laboratory site where the specimen was physically received.

manifestColumns.label: Received Date
manifestColumns.description: Date the specimen was received at the testing laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Received Time
manifestColumns.description: Time of day the specimen was received at the testing laboratory.

pages.title: Raw Sample Quality Check (QC)
pages.instructions: Perform quality checks on raw samples. Verify sample condition, volume, and suitability for processing.
pages.content: Raw Sample Quality Check (QC) - Quality assessment of incoming samples

criteria.label: Positive and negative smear controls included
DST EQA participation up to date

pages.title: Initial Sample Processing
pages.instructions: Perform initial processing steps including sample preparation and decontamination procedures.
pages.content: Initial Sample Processing - Sample preparation and decontamination

pages.title: Incubation & Monitoring
pages.instructions: Track weekly culture readings for inoculated samples. Monitor growth patterns over 8 weeks and record final culture results (positive, negative, or contaminated).
pages.content: Incubation & Monitoring - Weekly culture reading and growth tracking

pages.title: Assay/Test Execution
pages.instructions: Execute requested tests including culture, smear microscopy, GeneXpert, identification, and drug susceptibility testing. Record test results and methods used.
pages.content: Assay/Test Execution - Execute and record test results

pages.title: Isolate Storage
pages.instructions: Assign TB isolates to appropriate storage locations. Record storage location details and conditions for culture-positive samples.
pages.content: Isolate Storage - Assign isolates to storage locations

pages.title: Disposal & Archiving
pages.instructions: Dispose of completed samples or transfer to biorepository for long-term archiving. Track disposal reasons, methods, and maintain complete audit trail.

pages.title: Reporting
pages.instructions: View laboratory performance metrics, turnaround times, positivity rates, and resistance trends. Filter by date range to analyze workflow data.
pages.content: Reporting - Analytics and metrics for TB laboratory workflow
